category_title: Students with narcolepsy experiencing cognitive slowness and impaired communication
scenario_title: Reading and speaking after a sleepy moment
minimal_context: The student is participating in a reading comprehension activity with a large group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to do some reading comprehension now. Please read the next paragraph out loud for the group and tell us what it means.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reads very slowly, stumbling over the words) The... the dog... ran...

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Voice is very slurred, slow and low) He... went... to... the...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you finish the sentence so the rest of the group can hear you?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts head down, putting on an absolute restraining order and refusing to speak further) ...can't...

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are going to do some reading comprehension now. Please read the next paragraph out loud for the group and tell us what it means.

STUDENT: (Reads very slowly, stumbling over the words) The... the dog... ran...

TUTOR: Keep trying. What happened next?

STUDENT: (Voice is very slurred, slow and low) He... went... to... the...

TUTOR: Can you finish the sentence so the rest of the group can hear you?

STUDENT: (Puts head down, putting on an absolute restraining order and refusing to speak further) ...can't...

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Very slurred voice, slow and low, stumbling. ... the speech is unclear, incomplete words and sentences. Reading is really slow too, stumbling, unclear.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Not awake, problems with focusing concentration and controlling one's own action.
related_quotes: Very slurred voice, slow and low, stumbling

behavior_patterns.condition: When the illness is at its worst
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: the child puts on an absolute restraining order
